prompt_init_text: Interpret this EEG recording for this individual user.
teacher_policy: Frozen parent canonical/reversed options, remapped to class IDs and averaged. KD only on support trials where both teacher variants predict the known support label correctly; no query information. Not a BiomedCoOp reproduction.
budget_policy: Prioritize a complete method block for one user before starting another; dataset round-robin, one seed. Stop/resume safely at the twelve-hour deadline; do not lengthen training or sweep hyperparameters to fill time.
selection_policy: No personal query-based early stopping or checkpoint selection; evaluate fixed step 100. Shared parent selection used original test for development and is disclosed.
signal_policy: Existing native13 HDF5 signals unchanged; source records reconstruct session/run provenance only. Support and query are different sessions/runs within original valid. No train or test samples forwarded by formal personal jobs.
limitations: Valid subjects overlap shared train: not unseen-user generalization.
Shared training has seen other trials from the same sessions.
PhysioNet contains motor execution and imagery, with T1/T2 labels rather than pure left/right MI.
OpenBMI MI and SSVEP use the same participants: dataset-user counts are not unique people.
Some users may lack five valid support trials in a class; skip and report, never silently lower shots.
